K04's census rules, logged before the census runs (G56 and its readings 1 to 33, G56a). (1) A line shows K04 when it has a tag row: SHOW, ELAB, S-SHOW, S-OTHER, REJ and PART lines, and P-G6 lines marked PO; a room shows K04 when one of its lines does. (2) Forms are NA, CU, QU and CO; BE is the paired elaboration of the lead clause; OE, VE, FT, AC, PO, BT and CX are marks, and CX alone shows nothing (G56a). (3) Files: instantiate v3, restrict, add-condition, add-step, link, absent v2. (4) For the status ruling I weigh, by reasons and not by counts: (a) whether rooms show K04 in their own members' acts (OE), and how many only through visitors, only after the close or only in particulars; (b) whether any line corrects it (none did; three lines named P16, P17 or P12 and one link is a particular); (c) whether its two branches sit together: the rooms with CO, and how many of them also show a body from before (NA, CU or QU), against colour-faction rooms with no body from before; (d) its overlap with K03 on the sub's quarrel: the QU rooms that K03's tag files also show, and the rooms whose only K04 form is QU; (e) its overlap with C02 (rooms with C02 lines accepted as specifications in instantiate, restrict or add-condition, or rejected as absent); (f) the head's contrary condition, a faith deciding whom a room fights or admits (TeamYellowPlace-023's particular, AprilKnights-040, mcgill-025). The ruling chooses among: re-admit with the statement as written; re-admit with a stated bound; split the two branches; keep as a candidate; withdraw
